title: Late-Game Scenario Game
description: Live play from scenario cards (score, time and fouls) teaches the team to manage the clock, the foul count and the possession in the final minutes.

content.objective: Prepare the team to make calm, smart decisions in the last minutes of a close game: managing the clock, the foul count and the possession.
content.setup: Two teams of five play live from a scenario card that the coach reads out (score, time and fouls). An assistant or player runs the clock and keeps the score.
content.organization: Split the group into two teams and let extra players wait on the sideline and rotate in. Teams alternate offense and defense so both practice every situation.
instructions: Read the scenario aloud, for example: 'Down three with 25 seconds left and the ball, two fouls to give.' Start the clock and play it live.
Play the scenario to its end, then stop. Ask the players what the best next decision would have been and why.
Repeat the same scenario with the roles reversed.
Work through six to eight scenarios: down three with the ball, up two on defense, tied with one shot to take, out-of-bounds under your own basket, one-and-one free throws, and needing a quick two.
Finish with a full-speed two-minute game where the coach calls the score and the foul count at each dead ball.
coachingPoints: Know the score, the time and the foul situation on every possession.
Use timeouts and fouls on purpose, not by accident.
Stay calm: one clear call beats a rushed one.
Agree the plan before the ball is inbounded.
commonMistakes: Forgetting how many team fouls each side has.
Taking a quick shot with plenty of time left.
Fouling a shooter without thinking when the team is ahead.
content.safety: Intensity is high, so keep contact legal and stop play at once if a player is hurt.
progressions: Add a player as 'coach on the floor' who calls the play, and add crowd noise.
regressions: Play half-court only with a longer clock until the reads are clear.
variations: Let each team write its own scenario card for the other team.
Finish a scenario with free throws under pressure.
